notes: The controller drives power stages on the common PCB; heater load current must remain in the power section and must not flow through ESP32 logic.
START_REQUEST, RESET_REQUEST, SET_UP and SET_DOWN are active-low dry-contact inputs with external 10 kOhm pull-ups to 3.3 V.
STOP_STATUS is fail-safe: LOW means the normally-closed circuit is healthy; HIGH means STOP or an open wire.
No firmware build or host test constitutes authorization for fired operation. Commissioning values must be measured and explicitly accepted.
GPIO17 uses one motor channel: 0=constant LOW, 1..800=PWM, 1000=constant HIGH. 801..999 is rejected, never clamped. Schema-1 board-revision and two-speed profiles remain rejected.

A separate 220/24V presence input, TPS3808 and extra EN reset path are excluded. Normal power loss de-energizes the MCU; recovery restarts on the actual boot/reset after 24V returns. MAIN_POWER_OK and GPIO43 are not used.
The SSD1306/I2C panel is removed. ST7789V and both MAX31856 devices share SPI2 with independent chip selects and per-device mode/clock settings.

The selected seven-pin ST7789V module is write-only: no MISO/TE/presence feedback is available, so firmware can detect driver or transfer errors but cannot prove that an unplugged glass/module received pixels.

signals.name: RESET_REQUEST
signals.boot_rule: ignored until a debounced release has been observed

signals.name: START_REQUEST
signals.boot_rule: ignored until a debounced release has been observed

signals.name: STOP_STATUS
signals.external_bias: 10k pull-up to 3.3V plus normally-closed contact to ground

signals.name: SPEED_CMD
signals.frequency_hz: commissioned 77..20000; APB 80MHz, 10-bit resolution, checked divider and LEDC API result
signals.duty_permille: 0 static LOW; 1..800 active PWM; 1000 static HIGH; 801..999 rejected
signals.boot_rule: LOW/Hi-Z until a valid accepted schema-2 profile is loaded

signals.name: WATCHDOG_HEARTBEAT
signals.active: falling-edge service; toggled by completed control-loop passes

signals.name: SW_TRIP
signals.boot_rule: LOW/Hi-Z does not set latch; external watchdog handles MCU loss

display_contract.module: GMT020-02-7P VER1.3, ST7789V, 240x320, seven-pin write-only 4-wire SPI
display_contract.mounting: removable socket on the main PCB; not a remote panel
display_contract.supply: +3V3 only for this design; SPI logic is 3.3V
display_contract.reset: TFT_RESET_N follows DevKit EN/CHIP_PU; no separate reset GPIO. ESP-IDF ST7789 software reset and initialization run on every MCU boot, including esp_restart().

spi.max_update: one 240x40 RGB565 band per transaction cycle
spi.serialization: ESP-IDF SPI master serializes TFT and MAX31856 transactions; each device owns a separate CS and device configuration

display_contract.local_ui_fault: Detected initialization, queue or transfer failure latches FAULT_LOCAL_UI, keeps fuel/glow inhibited, and does not suppress required RECOVERY_PURGE airflow.
display_contract.physical_absence_limit: Because the module exposes no readback or presence signal, an electrically absent panel can still accept write calls at the SPI driver level. Physical presence/image/colors/orientation require bench inspection.

reset_contract.hardware_clear: PG_OK AND WD_OK AND STOP_OK AND THERMAL_OK AND ARM_READY AND NOT(SW_TRIP)
reset_contract.hardware_data: ARM_READY AND NOT(FUEL_CMD) AND NOT(FUEL_PERMIT) AND NOT(GLOW_CMD) AND START_RELEASED
protocol: A current fault keeps ARM_READY LOW or SW_TRIP HIGH, so asynchronous clear dominates RESET.
When only the open safety latch remains, firmware stays in LOCKOUT with safe outputs, ARM_READY HIGH and SW_TRIP LOW before the physical RESET edge.
The separate hardware RESET contact clocks the latch before the debounced GPIO6 request is processed.
Firmware must observe SAFETY_OK HIGH in a control-loop pass while RESET remains held; the release pass cannot newly qualify that RESET cycle.
A current blocker cancels the RESET qualification. RESET held through boot or a blocker cannot re-arm after recovery without release and a new physical edge; START remains a separate later action.

recovery_purge_contract.entry: every MCU boot/reset, regardless of the state before power loss
recovery_purge_contract.outputs: FUEL_CMD LOW, FUEL_PERMIT LOW, GLOW_CMD LOW, ARM_READY LOW, SW_TRIP HIGH; accepted PWM profile commands FAN_CMD and SPEED_CMD
recovery_purge_contract.completion: recovery_purge_min_ms elapsed from this boot AND all temperature samples valid/fresh AND STOP inactive AND exhaust/air at or below commissioned cool thresholds
recovery_purge_contract.blocked_config: invalid, unaccepted or schema-1 config keeps fan and SPEED_CMD off and cannot report recovery complete
recovery_purge_contract.request_policy: START and RESET are ignored until recovery completion; a held START requires release and a new press
recovery_purge_contract.power_loss_policy: a repeated power loss discards elapsed recovery time and starts the full interval again

watchdog_contract.supersedes_draft_01: Do not fit the earlier 10nF CWD capacitor; DRAFT-02 uses the fixed 200ms preset selected by the 10kohm pull-up.

fuel_permit_conditions: output adapter is healthy and no candidate configuration mutation awaits reboot
state is IGNITION_TRIAL, FLAME_CONFIRM, RUN_HIGH or RUN_LOW
watchdog heartbeat is serviced by the main state machine
both MAX31856 channels and the DS18B20 sample are valid and fresh
fan command is active and the timed preparation states completed
startup_invariants: Every boot/reset enters RECOVERY_PURGE before WAIT_COOLDOWN or LOCKOUT
FUEL_CMD and FUEL_PERMIT are both off before IGNITION_TRIAL
PREHEAT always commands glow and fan together; GLOW_CMD=HIGH with FAN_CMD=LOW is forbidden
fan operation continues through PREHEAT after PREPURGE
external independent post-purge is not bypassed by firmware
latched_fault_persistence: The software fault mask is stored in NVS, restored on every boot, and cleared only after a qualified manual RESET exits LOCKOUT.

motor_output_contract.status: DRAFT / BENCH ONLY; not a power-stage qualification or combustion approval
motor_output_contract.hardware_basis: LTC7001 + IRFB4110 candidate; motor_gate_supply_qualification.md firmware restriction, lines 31..37
motor_output_contract.static_levels: ESP-IDF 5.5.2 ESP32-S3 ledc_stop(LEDC_LOW_SPEED_MODE, LEDC_CHANNEL_0, 0 or 1); no recurring PWM edges
motor_output_contract.resume_pwm: stage fresh duty with ledc_set_duty, then ledc_update_duty re-enables signal output; check each result
motor_output_contract.requested_vs_physical: 1..800 maps to round(requested_permille*1024/1000) ticks per 1024-tick period; 1000 never maps to 1023 ticks. CLI applied_speed is successful command bookkeeping, not electrical GPIO feedback.
motor_output_contract.profiles: low_pwm_permille=1..800; recovery_purge_pwm_permille=1..800 or 1000; maximum-speed machine states retain 1000 static DC
motor_output_contract.frequency_validation: Fixed APB 80MHz/10bit, 18-bit divider with 8 fractional bits: divider=round((80000000<<8)/(Hz*1024)), 256..262143. Thus 1..76Hz is unachievable in this selected configuration and rejected as CONFIG_PWM, not silently adjusted.
motor_output_contract.configuration_changes: set/accept/revoke only while fan, fuel, permit and glow are OFF; serialized with the control/output pass. Any mutation attempt inhibits START until reboot. Runtime configuration remains immutable until reboot.
motor_output_contract.old_nvs: Digest-valid schema-2 profiles outside current limits lose in-memory acceptance, retain original values, report CONFIG_PWM and cannot START. Correct, validate, accept token, reboot, then qualified RESET for retained faults.
motor_output_contract.output_failure: Latched FAULT_OUTPUT; fuel, fuel permit, glow, ARM_READY and heartbeat LOW; SW_TRIP HIGH. Try LEDC stop LOW and independently detach GPIO17 to GPIO output LOW. Repeat shutdown on subsequent passes, never replay old HIGH/PWM; reboot required. Failed shutdown API results are recorded; software is not proof against a physically failed MCU/GPIO.
motor_output_contract.normal_stop_or_thermal_fault: Fuel OFF first; required fan post-purge remains at 1000 static HIGH until the existing machine commands zero. Only output-subsystem failure forces immediate motor OFF.
motor_output_contract.bench_required: Measure actual frequency/duty for 1..800; no recurring LOW dips at 1000 including repeated DC and PWM/DC transitions; GPIO17 LOW on actual command zero and injected adapter failure; preserve fuel-OFF-before-post-purge ordering. No physical measurement performed by host tests.
